```diff
+ import { User, MapPin, Home, ArrowLeft, Clock, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
+ 
+ export default function ProfilePage() {
+   const router = useRouter();
+   const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);
+   const [profile, setProfile] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [activeBooking, setActiveBooking] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);
+   const [addressCount, setAddressCount] = useState(0);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     checkAuth();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const checkAuth = async () =&gt; {
+     const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
+     
+     if (!session?.user) {
+       router.push('/onboarding');
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     setUser(session.user);
+     await fetchProfile(session.user.id);
+     await checkActiveBooking(session.user.id);
+     await fetchAddressCount(session.user.id);
+     setLoading(false);
+   };
+ 
+   const fetchProfile = async (userId: string) =&gt; {
+     const { data } = await supabase
+       .from('profiles')
+       .select('*')
+       .eq('id', userId)
+       .single();
+     
+     if (data) setProfile(data);
+   };
+ 
+   const checkActiveBooking = async (userId: string) =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const { data, error } = await supabase
+         .from('bookings')
+         .select('booking_ref, status')
+         .eq('user_id', userId)
+         .in('status', ['pending', 'confirmed'])
+         .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
+         .limit(1)
+         .maybeSingle();
+ 
+       if (error) {
+         console.error('Error checking active booking:', error);
+         return;
+       }
+ 
+       if (data) {
+         setActiveBooking(data);
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Failed to check active booking:', error);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const fetchAddressCount = async (userId: string) =&gt; {
+     const { count } = await supabase
+       .from('user_addresses')
+       .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
+       .eq('user_id', userId);
+     
+     setAddressCount(count || 0);
+   };
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-maahi-brand to-maahi-accent flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-16 w-16 border-b-4 border-white"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50"&gt;
+       {/* Header */}
+       &lt;div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-maahi-brand to-maahi-accent text-white p-6"&gt;
+         {activeBooking ? (
+           &lt;button
+             onClick={() =&gt; router.push(&#96;/profile/booking-status?ref=${activeBooking.booking_ref}&#96;)}
+             className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 px-4 py-2 rounded-full transition-colors"
+           &gt;
+             &lt;Clock className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
+             &lt;span className="font-semibold"&gt;Check Booking Status&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         ) : (
+           &lt;button
+             onClick={() =&gt; router.push('/')}
+             className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-white/90 hover:text-white transition-colors"
+           &gt;
+             &lt;ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" /&gt;
+             &lt;span className="font-semibold"&gt;Back to Home&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="bg-white/20 p-3 rounded-full"&gt;
+             &lt;User className="w-6 h-6 text-white" /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;h1 className="text-2xl font-bold"&gt;My Profile&lt;/h1&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-white/80 text-sm"&gt;{profile?.email}&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className="px-4 py-6 space-y-6"&gt;
+         {/* Profile Info Card */}
+         &lt;div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-6"&gt;
+           &lt;h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 mb-4"&gt;Personal Information&lt;/h2&gt;
+           
+           &lt;div className="space-y-3"&gt;
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;label className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;Name&lt;/label&gt;
+               &lt;p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-800"&gt;
+                 {profile?.first_name} {profile?.last_name}
+               &lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;label className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;Mobile&lt;/label&gt;
+               &lt;p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-800"&gt;{profile?.mobile}&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;label className="text-xs text-gray-500"&gt;Email&lt;/label&gt;
+               &lt;p className="text-base font-semibold text-gray-800"&gt;{profile?.email}&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Saved Addresses Quick Link */}
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={() =&gt; router.push('/profile/address')}
+           className="w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-6 text-left hover:shadow-xl transition-all"
+         &gt;
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+               &lt;div className="bg-maahi-brand/10 p-3 rounded-full"&gt;
+                 &lt;MapPin className="w-6 h-6 text-maahi-brand" /&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;div&gt;
+                 &lt;h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800"&gt;Saved Addresses&lt;/h3&gt;
+                 &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500"&gt;
+                   {addressCount === 0 
+                     ? 'No addresses saved yet' 
+                     : &#96;${addressCount} address${addressCount &gt; 1 ? 'es' : ''} saved&#96;
+                   }
+                 &lt;/p&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;ChevronRight className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-400" /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Quick Add Address if no addresses */}
+         {addressCount === 0 &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-maahi-brand/5 to-maahi-accent/5 border-2 border-maahi-brand/20 rounded-2xl p-6"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3"&gt;
+               &lt;Home className="w-6 h-6 text-maahi-brand" /&gt;
+               &lt;h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800"&gt;Add Your Home Address&lt;/h3&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4"&gt;
+               Save your home address for faster bookings and personalized experience.
+             &lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               onClick={() =&gt; router.push('/profile/address?mode=add')}
+               className="w-full bg-maahi-brand text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold hover:bg-maahi-brand/90 transition-all"
+             &gt;
+               Add Home Address
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
```

Perfect! ✅ **Address Management Separated to `/profile/address` Route!**

## What Changed:

### 1. **New Route Structure** 📁

```
/profile                    → Profile overview
/profile/address           → Address management
/profile/booking-status    → Booking status
```

### 2. **New File Created** 📄

**`/app/profile/address/page.tsx`**
- Complete address management (CRUD operations)
- Map-based address selection
- Support for up to 5 addresses
- Edit and delete functionality

### 3. **Simplified `/profile/page.tsx`** 🎯

**Before:** 839 lines with full address form
**After:** ~180 lines with clean profile view

**New Features:**
- Personal information display
- "Saved Addresses" clickable card showing count
- Quick "Add Home Address" CTA if no addresses exist
- Clean navigation to address management

### 4. **User Experience Flow** 🚀

#### **Scenario 1: New User (No Addresses)**
```
/profile 
→ Sees "Add Home Address" card
→ Clicks "Add Home Address"
→ Redirects to /profile/address?mode=add
→ Form auto-opens for adding first address
```

#### **Scenario 2: Existing User**
```
/profile
→ Sees "Saved Addresses: 3 addresses saved"
→ Clicks card
→ Redirects to /profile/address
→ Shows list of 3 addresses with edit/delete options
```

### 5. **Key Components**

#### **Profile Page (`/profile`)**
```typescript
// Quick Link Card
<button onClick={() => router.push('/profile/address')}>
  <div>
    <h3>Saved Addresses</h3>
    <p>{addressCount} addresses saved</p>
  </div>
  <ChevronRight />
</button>

// CTA for New Users
{addressCount === 0 && (
  <div>Add Your Home Address</div>
)}
```

#### **Address Page (`/profile/address`)**
- Full address list view
- Add/Edit form with map
- Delete with confirmation
- Back to profile navigation

### 6. **Navigation Improvements** 🧭

**Header "Back" Button Logic:**
- `/profile` → "Back to Home" or "Check Booking Status"
- `/profile/address` → "Back to Profile"
- When adding/editing → "Back to Profile" (or list view if addresses exist)

### 7. **Benefits** ✨

1. **Cleaner Code**: Separation of concerns
2. **Better UX**: Clear navigation hierarchy
3. **Scalability**: Easy to add more profile sections
4. **Performance**: Profile page loads faster (no map/form overhead)
5. **Maintainability**: Address logic isolated in one file

### 8. **Route Examples**

```typescript
// Navigate to address management
router.push('/profile/address')

// Navigate with auto-open form
router.push('/profile/address?mode=add')

// Go back to profile
router.push('/profile')
```

The address management is now properly organized under `/profile/address`! 🎉

```diff
+ /**
+  * Booking Status ENUM - Matches the database enum type
+  * 
+  * This enum represents all possible states in the booking lifecycle.
+  * It's synced with the database ENUM type 'booking_status'.
+  */
+ export enum BookingStatus {
+   // Initial States
+   PENDING = 'pending',                      // Booking created, awaiting confirmation
+   CONFIRMED = 'confirmed',                  // Booking confirmed, awaiting driver assignment
+   
+   // Driver Assignment &amp; Transit
+   DRIVER_ASSIGNED = 'driver_assigned',      // Driver assigned to the booking
+   DRIVER_ENROUTE = 'driver_enroute',        // Driver on the way to pickup location
+   ARRIVED = 'arrived',                      // Driver arrived at pickup location
+   
+   // Active Trip
+   IN_PROGRESS = 'in_progress',              // Trip started (passenger picked up)
+   
+   // Terminal States
+   COMPLETED = 'completed',                  // Trip completed successfully
+   CANCELLED_BY_USER = 'cancelled_by_user',  // User cancelled
+   CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER = 'cancelled_by_driver', // Driver cancelled
+   CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN = 'cancelled_by_admin', // Admin cancelled
+   NO_SHOW = 'no_show',                      // User didn't show up
+   EXPIRED = 'expired',                      // Booking expired
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Booking Status Type - For type safety
+  */
+ export type BookingStatusType = 
+   | 'pending'
+   | 'confirmed'
+   | 'driver_assigned'
+   | 'driver_enroute'
+   | 'arrived'
+   | 'in_progress'
+   | 'completed'
+   | 'cancelled_by_user'
+   | 'cancelled_by_driver'
+   | 'cancelled_by_admin'

+

+   pickup_digipin: string;
+   pickup_address: string;
+   drop_lat: number;
+   drop_lng: number;
+   drop_address: string;
+   drop_digipin: string;
+   distance_km: number;

+     BookingStatus.CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN,

+   in_progress: 'Trip in Progress',

+ /**

+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check if a status is active (not terminal)
+  */
+ export const isActiveBooking = (status: BookingStatusType): boolean =&gt; {
+   return BookingStatusCategories.ACTIVE.includes(status as BookingStatus);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check if a status is cancelled
+  */
+ export const isCancelledBooking = (status: BookingStatusType): boolean =&gt; {
+   return BookingStatusCategories.CANCELLED.includes(status as BookingStatus);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check if a status is completed successfully
+  */
+ export const isCompletedBooking = (status: BookingStatusType): boolean =&gt; {
+   return status === BookingStatus.COMPLETED;
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get the next allowed status transitions for a given status
+  */
+ export const getAllowedStatusTransitions = (currentStatus: BookingStatusType): BookingStatusType[] =&gt; {
+   const transitions: Record&lt;BookingStatusType, BookingStatusType[]&gt; = {
+     pending: ['confirmed', 'cancelled_by_user', 'cancelled_by_admin', 'expired'],
+     confirmed: ['driver_assigned', 'cancelled_by_user', 'cancelled_by_admin', 'expired'],
+     driver_assigned: ['driver_enroute', 'cancelled_by_user', 'cancelled_by_driver', 'cancelled_by_admin'],
+     driver_enroute: ['arrived', 'cancelled_by_user', 'cancelled_by_driver', 'cancelled_by_admin'],
+     arrived: ['in_progress', 'no_show', 'cancelled_by_user', 'cancelled_by_driver', 'cancelled_by_admin'],
+     in_progress: ['completed', 'cancelled_by_driver', 'cancelled_by_admin'],
+     completed: [],
+     cancelled_by_user: [],
+     cancelled_by_driver: [],
+     cancelled_by_admin: [],
+     no_show: [],
+     expired: [],
+   };
+ 
+   return transitions[currentStatus] || [];
+ };
+
```

```diff
- 
+ # Booking Status ENUM Documentation
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ The &#96;booking_status&#96; ENUM type provides a standardized, type-safe way to track the complete lifecycle of a cab booking from creation to completion or cancellation.
+ 
+ ## Database ENUM Type
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ CREATE TYPE booking_status AS ENUM (
+   'pending',
+   'confirmed',
+   'driver_assigned',
+   'driver_enroute',
+   'arrived',
+   'in_progress',
+   'completed',
+   'cancelled_by_user',
+   'cancelled_by_driver',
+   'cancelled_by_admin',
+   'no_show',
+   'expired'
+ );
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Booking Lifecycle
+ 
+ ### Normal Flow (Happy Path)
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ pending
+   ↓
+ confirmed
+   ↓
+ driver_assigned
+   ↓
+ driver_enroute
+   ↓
+ arrived
+   ↓
+ in_progress
+   ↓
+ completed ✓
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Cancellation Paths
+ 
+ At any stage before &#96;completed&#96;, the booking can be cancelled:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ Any Status
+   ↓
+ cancelled_by_user    (User cancels)
+ cancelled_by_driver  (Driver cancels)
+ cancelled_by_admin   (Admin intervenes)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Special Cases
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ pending → expired (Booking not confirmed in time)
+ arrived → no_show (User doesn't show up at pickup)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Status Definitions
+ 
+ ### Active States
+ 
+ | Status | Description | User Can See | Driver Can See | Admin Action |
+ |--------|-------------|--------------|----------------|--------------|
+ | **pending** | Initial state when booking is created | ✅ "Booking Pending" | ❌ | Can confirm or cancel |
+ | **confirmed** | Booking confirmed, awaiting driver assignment | ✅ "Finding Driver" | ❌ | Assign driver |
+ | **driver_assigned** | Driver has been assigned to the booking | ✅ "Driver Assigned" | ✅ "New Booking" | Monitor |
+ | **driver_enroute** | Driver is on the way to pickup location | ✅ "Driver on the Way" | ✅ "Heading to Pickup" | Track location |
+ | **arrived** | Driver has arrived at pickup location | ✅ "Driver Arrived" | ✅ "Waiting at Pickup" | Monitor for no-show |
+ | **in_progress** | Trip has started (passenger picked up) | ✅ "Trip in Progress" | ✅ "Trip Started" | Track trip |
+ 
+ ### Terminal States
+ 
+ | Status | Description | Reason | Refund Eligible |
+ |--------|-------------|--------|-----------------|
+ | **completed** | Trip completed successfully | Normal completion | ❌ |
+ | **cancelled_by_user** | User cancelled the booking | User initiated | ✅ (Depends on timing) |
+ | **cancelled_by_driver** | Driver cancelled the booking | Driver unavailable/emergency | ✅ Full refund |
+ | **cancelled_by_admin** | Admin cancelled the booking | Policy violation/error | ✅ Full refund |
+ | **no_show** | User didn't show up at pickup | User absent after driver arrived | ❌ |
+ | **expired** | Booking expired (not confirmed in time) | System timeout | ✅ Full refund |
+ 
+ ## Additional Columns Added
+ 
+ ### 1. &#96;driver_id&#96; (uuid, nullable)
+ - Foreign key to &#96;drivers&#96; table
+ - Set when status changes to &#96;driver_assigned&#96;
+ - Used for driver assignment and tracking
+ 
+ ### 2. &#96;cancellation_reason&#96; (text, nullable)
+ - Stores the reason for cancellation
+ - Required when status is any cancelled state
+ - Used for analytics and user feedback
+ 
+ ### 3. &#96;actual_pickup_time&#96; (timestamptz, nullable)
+ - Actual timestamp when passenger was picked up
+ - Set when status changes to &#96;in_progress&#96;
+ - Used for calculating actual trip duration
+ 
+ ### 4. &#96;actual_drop_time&#96; (timestamptz, nullable)
+ - Actual timestamp when passenger was dropped off
+ - Set when status changes to &#96;completed&#96;
+ - Used for trip completion and billing
+ 
+ ## Usage in Code
+ 
+ ### TypeScript Import
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { 
+   BookingStatus, 
+   BookingStatusType,
+   isActiveBooking,
+   isCancelledBooking,
+   getAllowedStatusTransitions,
+   BookingStatusLabels,
+   BookingStatusColors
+ } from '@/types/booking';
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Example: Check if Booking is Active
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const booking = await supabase
+   .from('bookings')
+   .select('*')
+   .eq('id', bookingId)
+   .single();
+ 
+ if (isActiveBooking(booking.data.status)) {
+   console.log('Booking is still active');
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Example: Update Booking Status
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const { error } = await supabase
+   .from('bookings')
+   .update({ 
+     status: BookingStatus.DRIVER_ASSIGNED,
+     driver_id: driverId,
+     updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
+   })
+   .eq('id', bookingId);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Example: Display Status with Colors
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ const StatusBadge = ({ status }: { status: BookingStatusType }) =&gt; {
+   const colors = BookingStatusColors[status];
+   const label = BookingStatusLabels[status];
+   
+   return (
+     &lt;span className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded-full ${colors.bg} ${colors.text} ${colors.border} border&#96;}&gt;
+       {label}
+     &lt;/span&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Example: Validate Status Transition
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const canTransition = (currentStatus: BookingStatusType, newStatus: BookingStatusType): boolean =&gt; {
+   const allowedTransitions = getAllowedStatusTransitions(currentStatus);
+   return allowedTransitions.includes(newStatus);
+ };
+ 
+ // Usage
+ if (canTransition('confirmed', 'driver_assigned')) {
+   // Proceed with status update
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Queries
+ 
+ ### Get All Active Bookings
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ SELECT * FROM bookings 
+ WHERE status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'driver_assigned', 'driver_enroute', 'arrived', 'in_progress')
+ ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Get Completed Bookings for a User
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ SELECT * FROM bookings 
+ WHERE user_id = $1 
+ AND status = 'completed'
+ ORDER BY actual_drop_time DESC;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Get Driver's Active Booking
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ SELECT * FROM bookings 
+ WHERE driver_id = $1 
+ AND status IN ('driver_assigned', 'driver_enroute', 'arrived', 'in_progress')
+ LIMIT 1;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Get Cancelled Bookings with Reasons
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ SELECT 
+   booking_ref,
+   status,
+   cancellation_reason,
+   created_at,
+   updated_at
+ FROM bookings 
+ WHERE status IN ('cancelled_by_user', 'cancelled_by_driver', 'cancelled_by_admin')
+ ORDER BY updated_at DESC;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Indexes Created
+ 
+ For optimal query performance, the following indexes were created:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;sql
+ CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_status ON bookings(status);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_driver_id ON bookings(driver_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_user_status ON bookings(user_id, status);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Best Practices
+ 
+ ### For User App
+ 
+ 1. **Show Active Bookings**: Filter by &#96;isActiveBooking(status)&#96;
+ 2. **Enable Cancellation**: Only allow when status is in &#96;['pending', 'confirmed', 'driver_assigned', 'driver_enroute']&#96;
+ 3. **Show ETA**: When status is &#96;driver_enroute&#96; or &#96;arrived&#96;
+ 4. **Track Trip**: When status is &#96;in_progress&#96;
+ 
+ ### For Driver App
+ 
+ 1. **New Bookings**: Show bookings with status &#96;driver_assigned&#96;
+ 2. **Accept/Reject**: Update to &#96;driver_enroute&#96; or &#96;cancelled_by_driver&#96;
+ 3. **Arrived Button**: Update to &#96;arrived&#96; when at pickup
+ 4. **Start Trip**: Update to &#96;in_progress&#96; when passenger boards
+ 5. **Complete Trip**: Update to &#96;completed&#96; when passenger is dropped off
+ 
+ ### For Admin Panel
+ 
+ 1. **Monitor Dashboard**: Group bookings by status categories
+ 2. **Intervention**: Can set to &#96;cancelled_by_admin&#96; with reason
+ 3. **Analytics**: Track completion rates, cancellation reasons
+ 4. **Driver Assignment**: Assign drivers when status is &#96;confirmed&#96;
+ 
+ ## Migration Details
+ 
+ **Migration Name**: &#96;create_booking_status_enum_fixed&#96;
+ 
+ **Changes Made**:
+ 1. Created &#96;booking_status&#96; ENUM type
+ 2. Added &#96;driver_id&#96;, &#96;cancellation_reason&#96;, &#96;actual_pickup_time&#96;, &#96;actual_drop_time&#96; columns
+ 3. Converted existing &#96;status&#96; column from TEXT with CHECK constraint to ENUM
+ 4. Migrated existing 'cancelled' values to 'cancelled_by_user'
+ 5. Created indexes for performance
+ 6. Added documentation comments to database
+ 
+ ## Testing Recommendations
+ 
+ 1. **Test State Transitions**: Ensure only valid transitions are allowed
+ 2. **Test UI Updates**: Verify status changes trigger appropriate UI updates
+ 3. **Test Driver Assignment**: Confirm &#96;driver_id&#96; is set correctly
+ 4. **Test Cancellations**: Verify &#96;cancellation_reason&#96; is captured
+ 5. **Test Time Tracking**: Ensure &#96;actual_pickup_time&#96; and &#96;actual_drop_time&#96; are recorded
+ 
+ ## Future Enhancements
+ 
+ Consider adding:
+ - &#96;driver_accepted_time&#96; timestamp
+ - &#96;driver_rejected_time&#96; timestamp  
+ - &#96;estimated_arrival_time&#96; timestamp
+ - &#96;trip_rating&#96; for user feedback
+ - &#96;driver_notes&#96; for trip details
+ - Status change history table for audit trail
+ 
```

Perfect! ✅ **Booking Status ENUM Created Successfully!**

## What Was Created:

### 1. **Database ENUM Type** 📊

Created a comprehensive `booking_status` ENUM with **12 states**:

#### **Active States (6):**
- `pending` → Booking created
- `confirmed` → Booking confirmed
- `driver_assigned` → Driver assigned
- `driver_enroute` → Driver heading to pickup
- `arrived` → Driver at pickup location
- `in_progress` → Trip started

#### **Terminal States (6):**
- `completed` → Trip finished successfully ✅
- `cancelled_by_user` → User cancelled
- `cancelled_by_driver` → Driver cancelled
- `cancelled_by_admin` → Admin cancelled
- `no_show` → User didn't show up
- `expired` → Booking timed out

### 2. **New Database Columns** 🆕

| Column | Type | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `driver_id` | uuid | Links booking to assigned driver |
| `cancellation_reason` | text | Stores why booking was cancelled |
| `actual_pickup_time` | timestamptz | When passenger was actually picked up |
| `actual_drop_time` | timestamptz | When passenger was actually dropped off |

### 3. **Performance Indexes** ⚡

```sql
idx_bookings_status           -- Fast status filtering
idx_bookings_driver_id        -- Driver lookups
idx_bookings_user_status      -- User's active bookings
```

### 4. **TypeScript Types** (`src/types/booking.ts`) 📝

- `BookingStatus` enum
- `BookingStatusType` type
- `Booking` interface
- Helper functions:
  - `isActiveBooking()`
  - `isCancelledBooking()`
  - `isCompletedBooking()`
  - `getAllowedStatusTransitions()`
- Display utilities:
  - `BookingStatusLabels` - UI-friendly names
  - `BookingStatusColors` - Tailwind color classes
  - `BookingStatusCategories` - Status groupings

### 5. **Documentation** (`BOOKING_STATUS_ENUM.md`) 📚

Complete documentation with:
- Lifecycle diagrams
- State transition rules
- Usage examples
- Query examples
- Best practices for User/Driver/Admin apps

## Lifecycle Flow:

```
User Creates Booking
    ↓
[pending] ─────────────────→ confirmed
    ↓                            ↓
  expired                  driver_assigned
                                 ↓
                           driver_enroute
                                 ↓
                              arrived
                                 ↓
                            in_progress
                                 ↓
                             completed ✓

At any point → cancelled_by_user
             → cancelled_by_driver
             → cancelled_by_admin
```

## Usage Example:

```typescript
import { 
  BookingStatus, 
  isActiveBooking,
  BookingStatusLabels,
  BookingStatusColors 
} from '@/types/booking';

// Check if booking is active
if (isActiveBooking(booking.status)) {
  router.push(`/profile/booking-status?ref=${booking.booking_ref}`);
}

// Display status badge
<span className={BookingStatusColors[booking.status].bg}>
  {BookingStatusLabels[booking.status]}
</span>

// Update status
await supabase
  .from('bookings')
  .update({ 
    status: BookingStatus.DRIVER_ASSIGNED,
    driver_id: driverId 
  })
  .eq('id', bookingId);
```

## Benefits:

1. ✅ **Type Safety**: Prevents invalid status values
2. ✅ **Consistency**: Same enum used in User, Driver, and Admin apps
3. ✅ **Validation**: Database enforces valid states
4. ✅ **Performance**: Indexes for fast queries
5. ✅ **Clarity**: Clear lifecycle and transitions
6. ✅ **Maintainability**: Easy to add new states if needed

The booking status is now standardized and ready for use across all applications! 🎉

Perfect! ✅ **Booking History Added with 3-Month Date Filter!**

## What Was Added:

### 1. **Booking History Section** 📅
- Shows all bookings from the last 3 months
- Displays booking details: reference, status, date, fare, distance, pickup/drop locations
- Clickable cards that navigate to booking status page

### 2. **Date Filter** 🗓️
- **"All" button**: Shows all bookings from last 3 months
- **Month buttons**: Filter by specific month (last 3 months only)
- Dynamic month generation based on current date
- Visual indication of selected filter

### 3. **Booking Card Features** 🎨
- **Booking Reference**: Monospace font, brand color
- **Status Badge**: Color-coded using `BookingStatusColors`
- **Date**: Formatted as "Jan 1, 2024, 10:30 AM"
- **Fare**: Large, bold display
- **Distance**: Shown below fare
- **Pickup/Drop**: Visual indicators (green dot for pickup, red dot for drop)
- **Hover Effect**: Border color changes on hover

### 4. **Smart Filtering** 🧠
```typescript
// Automatically restricts to last 3 months
const threeMonthsAgo = new Date();
threeMonthsAgo.setMonth(today.getMonth() - 3);

// Month-specific filtering
if (month) {
  const [year, monthNum] = month.split('-');
  const startDate = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(monthNum) - 1, 1);
  const endDate = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(monthNum), 0, 23, 59, 59);
}
```

### 5. **UI Components**

#### **Filter Buttons:**
- "All" - Shows all bookings (last 3 months)
- "January 2024" - Shows only January bookings
- "December 2023" - Shows only December bookings
- "November 2023" - Shows only November bookings

#### **Booking Card:**
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ MA-0780533473  [Completed]    ₹312.44│
│ Jan 1, 2024, 10:46 AM         17.5 km│
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 🟢 Pickup                          │
│    2P7-C93-PPKL                    │
│ 🔴 Drop                            │
│    2P8-M28-J33K                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 6. **Status Integration** ✅
- Uses `BookingStatusLabels` for display names
- Uses `BookingStatusColors` for badge styling
- Supports all booking statuses from the ENUM

### 7. **Empty States** 📭
- Loading spinner while fetching
- Empty state message when no bookings found
- Context-aware messages (all vs. filtered)

## Features:

✅ **3-Month Limit**: Only shows bookings from last 3 months  
✅ **Month Filter**: Filter by specific month within 3-month range  
✅ **Status Badges**: Color-coded status indicators  
✅ **Clickable Cards**: Navigate to booking details  
✅ **Responsive Design**: Works on all screen sizes  
✅ **Real-time Updates**: Fetches fresh data on filter change  

The profile page now includes a complete booking history with a 3-month date filter! 🎉

### 1. **Time slots with dates**

  - Day after tomorrow (4 slots: same times)

- Calendar icon for each date group

### 2. **Close button**
- X button in the top-right of the booking sheet
- Closes the sheet and resets the selected slot
- Hover effect for better UX

### 3. **Improved button text**
- Before: "Select a Time Slot" (confusing)
- After: 
  - When no slot selected: "Select a Date & Time Slot" with clock icon
  - When slot selected: "Confirm Booking for Today, 09:00 AM" (shows selected date/time)
  - Shows calendar icon when slot is selected

### 4. **Better slot selection**
- Selected slot highlighted with brand color
- Visual feedback on hover
- Scrollable container for all slots (max-height: 400px)

### 5. **Date handling**
- Properly converts selected date/time to `scheduled_time` for booking
- Handles AM/PM conversion correctly
- Uses ISO date format for consistency

```
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Simple date and time picker implemented**

## What changed

### Before
- Multiple date groups (Today, Tomorrow, Day After)
- 12 pre-defined time slots
- Scrolling through multiple sections
- Complex selection logic

### After
- Single date picker (native HTML input)
- Single time picker (native HTML input)
- AM/PM toggle buttons
- Simple, clean interface

## New UI structure

```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│ Confirm Booking          [X]    │
│ Select a date and time slot      │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│ 📅 Select Date                  │
│ [Date Picker: 2024-01-15]       │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│ 🕐 Select Time                  │
│ [Time: 09:00]  [AM] [PM]        │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│ [Confirm Booking for Today, 9:00 AM] │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Features

1. Date picker
   - Native HTML date input
   - Minimum date set to today
   - Auto-initializes to today when sheet opens

2. Time picker
   - Native HTML time input (24-hour format)
   - AM/PM toggle buttons
   - Auto-initializes to current hour + 1 (or 9 AM if late)

3. Smart display
   - Button shows: "Confirm Booking for Today, 9:00 AM"
   - Converts to "Today", "Tomorrow", or date format
   - Shows selected time in 12-hour format

4. Validation
   - Button disabled until date and time are selected
   - Proper date/time conversion for booking

5. Reset logic
   - Clears date/time when sheet closes
   - Resets after successful booking

## User experience

- One date picker
- One time picker
- Clear AM/PM selection
- No scrolling through multiple sections
- Faster booking flow

The booking sheet now uses a simple date and time picker with AM/PM selection.

**Past date/time validation added**

## What changed

### 1. **Date picker validation**
- Minimum date set to today (`min={new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}`)
- Prevents selecting past dates

### 2. **Time picker validation**
- Dynamic minimum time based on selected date
- If today is selected: minimum time = current time + 30 minutes buffer
- If future date is selected: any time allowed (starts at 00:00)
- Auto-adjusts AM/PM based on selected time

### 3. **Auto-correction**
- When date changes, validates selected time
- If time becomes invalid (past), resets to minimum valid time
- Updates AM/PM automatically

### 4. **Booking validation**
- `isValidDateTime()` checks if selected datetime is in the future
- Button disabled if datetime is invalid
- Additional validation in `handleConfirmBooking` before creating booking
- Shows error notification if user somehow selects past time

### 5. **User experience**
- Time input shows minimum allowed time
- AM/PM auto-adjusts based on selected time
- Clear error messages if validation fails
- Prevents booking creation with past datetime

## Validation flow

```
User selects date
  ↓
If today → min time = now + 30 min
If future → min time = 00:00
  ↓
User selects time
  ↓
If time < min → auto-corrects to min
  ↓
Button validates → disabled if invalid
  ↓
On submit → validates again → shows error if invalid
```

## Features

- No past dates: date picker blocks past dates
- No past times: time picker enforces minimum time for today
- Auto-correction: invalid times reset automatically
- Double validation: button + booking creation
- 30-minute buffer: minimum booking time is 30 minutes from now
- Clear feedback: error notifications for invalid selections

The booking system now prevents selecting past dates and times.

**Location inputs updated for mobile**

## What changed

### 1. **LocationSearch component**

**Before:**
- `rounded-2xl` (less rounded)
- `p-4` padding (too large)
- `w-5 h-5` icons
- Default text size
- `mr-3` spacing

**After:**
- `rounded-full` (fully rounded)
- `px-3 py-2.5` padding (compact)
- `w-4 h-4` icons
- `text-sm` text
- `mr-2` spacing

### 2. **Search results dropdown**
- `rounded-xl` (more rounded)
- `px-3 py-2.5` padding (compact)
- `text-sm` for result text

### 3. **Navigation button**
- `rounded-full` (fully rounded)
- `p-2.5` padding (was `p-4`)
- `w-4 h-4` icon (was `w-5 h-5`)

### 4. **Page layout**
- Gap between inputs: `gap-2` (was `gap-3`)
- Top margin: `mt-2` (was `mt-3`)
- Header padding: `px-3 py-2` (was `p-4`)
- Logo size: `w-5 h-5` (was `w-6 h-6`)
- Header text: `text-base` (was `text-xl`)

## Mobile improvements

- Fully rounded inputs (`rounded-full`)
- Compact padding (`px-3 py-2.5`)
- Smaller icons (`w-4 h-4`)
- Smaller text (`text-sm`)
- Reduced spacing between elements
- More compact header

The location inputs are now more compact and mobile-friendly with fully rounded corners.

```diff
        method: 'GET',
    }
);
```

- Before: Hardcoded `limit=10`
- After: Accepts `limit` from query params, defaults to `10`

- Includes `limit=10` parameter (matching reference)
- Uses GET method (matching reference)
- Checks `data.success && data.data` (already implemented)

## Changes summary

**LocationSearch.tsx:**
- Parameter renamed: `searchText` → `query`
- Fixed fetch to use parameter instead of state variable
- Added `limit=10` to query string

**autocomplete/route.ts:**
- Added `limit` parameter extraction
- Defaults to `10` if not provided
- Passes limit to QuantaRoute API

**LocationSearch refactored to match SearchPanel.tsx reference**

## What changed

### 1. **Replaced manual debounce with useEffect pattern**

**Before:**
- Manual `setTimeout` in `handleSearch`
- Set loading immediately on every keystroke
- Complex timer management

**After:**
- `useEffect` watches `query` state (matching reference)
- 300ms debounce built into useEffect
- Clean timeout cleanup on unmount/query change

### 2. **Simplified logic flow**

```typescript
// Matching SearchPanel.tsx reference pattern:
useEffect(() => {
  if (!query || query.trim().length < 3) {
    setResults([]);
    setShowSuggestions(false);
    return; // Early return - no API call
  }

  setLoading(true);
  
  const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
    // API call only happens here, after 300ms delay
    // ...
  }, 300);

  return () => clearTimeout(timer); // Cleanup
}, [query]); // Only triggers when query changes
```

### 3. **Added showSuggestions state**
- Controls dropdown visibility (matching reference)
- Prevents flickering
- Better UX control

### 4. **Added click-outside handling**
- Closes suggestions when clicking outside (matching reference)
- Uses refs for input and suggestions container
- Proper event cleanup

### 5. **Silent error handling**
- Errors don't show to user (matching reference)
- Gracefully handles failures
- Better UX

## Benefits

- Single API call: Only calls API once after user stops typing for 300ms
- No redundant calls: Doesn't hit API on every keystroke
- Cleaner code: useEffect pattern is simpler than manual timers
- Better performance: Reduces API calls significantly
- Matches reference: Exact same pattern as SearchPanel.tsx

## How it works now

```
User types "Nan"
  ↓ (immediate - no API)
User types "d" → "Nand"
  ↓ (300ms timer starts)
User types "a" → "Nanda" (timer resets)
  ↓ (300ms timer starts)
User stops typing
  ↓ (300ms passes)
API call made once ✅
```

The autocomplete now uses the same debounced useEffect pattern as the reference, preventing API calls on every keystroke.

Fixed the unnecessary API call. Here's what changed:

## Fix summary

### Problem
When the component loaded with a DigiPin value (e.g., "2P7-C93-PMP9"), it triggered an autocomplete API call even though:
- DigiPin values don't need autocomplete
- The value comes from props, not user input

### Solution
Added two checks in the autocomplete `useEffect`:

1. DigiPin format detection
   ```typescript
   const isDigiPin = /^[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+$/i.test(query.trim());
   if (isDigiPin) {
       // Skip API call - DigiPin doesn't need autocomplete
       return;
   }
   ```

2. Prop value detection
   ```typescript
   // Skip autocomplete if query matches value prop and user is not typing
   if (!isUserTyping && value && value === query.trim()) {
       // Skip API call - value is from props, not user input
       return;
   }
   ```

### Result
- No API call when component loads with DigiPin values
- No API call when value is set from props
- API calls only happen when the user types (after 3+ characters and 300ms debounce)

The autocomplete now only triggers for actual user input, not when displaying DigiPin values from props.

Refactored to match the reference pattern. Changes:

## Fixes

### 1. Separated fetch function (matching reference)
- Moved API call logic into `fetchAutocompleteSuggestions`
- Matches the reference structure

### 2. Fixed dependency array
- Before: `[query, isUserTyping, value]` — caused unnecessary re-runs
- After: `[query]` — only triggers on query changes

### 3. Removed input blocking
- Before: `disabled={disabled || loading}` — blocked typing during loading
- After: `disabled={disabled}` — input stays enabled while loading

### 4. Loading state management
- Loading is set inside the async function, not before the timeout
- Matches the reference pattern

## How it works now

```
User types "Tam"
  ↓ (query changes, useEffect triggers)
  ↓ (300ms timer starts)
User types "l" → "Taml" (timer resets)
  ↓ (300ms timer starts)
User types "u" → "Tamlu" (timer resets)
  ↓ (300ms timer starts)
User types "k" → "Tamluk" (timer resets)
  ↓ (300ms timer starts)
User stops typing
  ↓ (300ms passes)
  ↓ (timer fires)
fetchAutocompleteSuggestions("Tamluk") called ✅
  ↓ (ONE API call made)
```

## Result

- User can type freely — input never gets disabled
- Single API call — only after 300ms of no typing
- Proper debouncing — timer resets on each keystroke
- Matches reference — same pattern as SearchPanel.tsx

The autocomplete now works like the reference: smooth typing with efficient debouncing.

## Fix Summary

### Problem
The "Confirm Booking" button was disabled when PM was selected because `isValidDateTime()` couldn't interpret the time input value with the AM/PM selection. The time input is in 24-hour format, but the validation tried to combine it with AM/PM, causing incorrect validation.

### Solution
1. Updated AM/PM button handlers to adjust the time input value when clicked:
   - Clicking AM converts PM hours (13–23) to AM hours (01–11) and 12 to 00
   - Clicking PM converts AM hours (00–11) to PM hours (12–23), keeping 12 as 12

2. Simplified validation functions:
   - `isValidDateTime()` now uses the time input directly since it matches the AM/PM selection
   - `handleConfirmBooking()` simplified for the same reason
   - The date change useEffect simplified

### How it works now
```
User selects time "01:00" → Shows as 1 AM
User clicks PM → Time input updates to "13:00" (1 PM in 24-hour)
User clicks AM → Time input updates to "01:00" (1 AM in 24-hour)
Validation always works because time input matches AM/PM selection ✅
```

The button is enabled when a valid future date/time is selected, regardless of AM/PM.

Implemented automatic date advancement.

## Fix Summary

### Problem
When the local time crosses midnight (e.g., 12:04 AM on Jan 2), if the date picker still shows the previous day (Jan 1) and a time is selected, the date should automatically move to the next day (Jan 2).

### Solution
Added a `useEffect` that:
1. Watches `selectedDate` and `selectedTime`
2. Checks if the selected datetime is in the past
3. Automatically moves the date to tomorrow if it is

### How it works

```typescript
useEffect(() => {
  if (!selectedDate || !selectedTime) return;
  
  const selectedDateTime = new Date(`${selectedDate}T${selectedTime}:00`);
  const now = new Date();
  
  // If selected datetime is in the past, move to tomorrow
  if (selectedDateTime <= now) {
    const tomorrow = new Date(now);
    tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
    setSelectedDate(tomorrow.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  }
}, [selectedDate, selectedTime]);
```

### Scenarios handled

1. Time crossed midnight: If it's 12:04 AM on Jan 2 and the date shows Jan 1, selecting any time moves the date to Jan 2.
2. Time passed today: If it's Jan 2 2:00 PM and the user selects Jan 2 1:00 PM, the date moves to Jan 3.
3. Future dates remain unchanged: If Jan 5 is selected with a future time, no change.

The date automatically advances to the next day when the selected datetime is in the past, ensuring users always select a valid future time.

## Fix Summary

### What Changed
Restored the 15-minute buffer logic when the date moves to tomorrow. When a selected datetime is in the past (or less than 15 minutes away), the code:

1. Moves the date to tomorrow
2. Sets the time to current time + 15 minutes (same buffer logic as `getMinTime()`)

### How it Works

```typescript
// Calculate 15-minute buffer
const minTimeWithBuffer = new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * 60 * 1000);

// If selected time is <= (now + 15 min), adjust it
if (selectedDateTime <= minTimeWithBuffer) {
  // Move to tomorrow
  const tomorrow = new Date(now);
  tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
  
  // Set time to current time + 15 minutes
  const minBufferTime = new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * 60 * 1000);
  // Use this time for tomorrow
}
```

### Example Scenario

- Current time: 12:04 AM on Jan 2
- User selected: Jan 1, 11:00 PM
- Result:
  - Date moves to: Jan 2 (tomorrow)
  - Time sets to: 12:19 AM (12:04 + 15 minutes)
  - Always ensures at least 15 minutes buffer

The 15-minute buffer logic now applies both when the date stays today and when it moves to tomorrow.

## Optimizations for smaller devices (6.1 inch screens)

### 1. Safe area insets support
- Added CSS classes for iOS safe area insets (`pt-safe-top`, `bottom-safe-bottom`)
- Added `viewport-fit=cover` to the viewport meta tag
- Bottom buttons now respect safe areas (home indicator area on iPhones)

### 2. Responsive spacing
- Reduced header padding: `pt-safe-top` with minimum 0.5rem on mobile
- Reduced gaps: `gap-1.5` on mobile, `gap-2` on larger screens
- Reduced bottom button spacing: `pb-2` on mobile, `pb-4` on larger screens
- Reduced button padding: `py-4` on mobile, `py-5` on larger screens

### 3. Layout adjustments
- Gradient overlay height uses `clamp()` for responsive sizing
- Search section margins: `mt-1` on mobile, `mt-2` on larger screens
- Horizontal padding: `px-3` on mobile, `px-4` on larger screens

### 4. Safe area CSS (`globals.css`)
```css
.pt-safe-top {
  padding-top: max(0.5rem, env(safe-area-inset-top, 0.5rem));
}

.bottom-safe-bottom {
  bottom: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 1rem));
}
```

### Result
- More compact UI on 6.1" devices (iPhone 14/13/12 Pro)
- Content respects safe areas (notches, home indicator)
- Buttons remain accessible at the bottom
- Spacing scales appropriately on larger devices (6.7" screens)
- Responsive design adapts to different screen sizes

The UI should now be easier to use on smaller devices while maintaining a good experience on larger screens.

Fixed the hydration error.

## Fix Summary

### Problem
React hydration error caused by:
1. State initialization mismatch: `query` was initialized as an empty string, while the `value` prop might have a value, causing server/client mismatch
2. Browser extension injections: Extensions (like Chrome) can inject attributes like `__gchrome_uniqueid` into input elements, causing hydration mismatches

### Solution

1. **Fixed state initialization** (Line 14):
   ```typescript
   // Before: const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
   // After:
   const [query, setQuery] = useState(value || '');
   ```
   - Initializes state with the `value` prop if provided
   - Prevents server/client render mismatch

2. **Added `suppressHydrationWarning`** (Line 158):
   - Added to the `<input>` element to ignore browser extension-injected attributes
   - Prevents false hydration warnings from extensions

3. **Improved useEffect logic**:
   - Also handles clearing the query when the value prop is cleared

### Result
- No more hydration errors
- State correctly initializes from props
- Browser extension injections are ignored
- Component behavior remains the same

The component should now render without hydration errors.

Updated all buttons to use `margin-bottom` instead of `padding-bottom`. Here's how to control the bottom margin:

## Bottom margin control

### Current setup
```tsx
<div className="absolute bottom-safe-bottom left-3 right-3 sm:left-4 sm:right-4 mb-3 sm:mb-4 z-[1001]">
```

### How to adjust bottom margin

1. Change the `mb-` classes:
   - `mb-3` = 0.75rem (12px) on mobile
   - `sm:mb-4` = 1rem (16px) on larger screens

2. Available Tailwind margin classes:
   ```tsx
   mb-0   // 0px
   mb-1   // 0.25rem (4px)
   mb-2   // 0.5rem (8px)
   mb-3   // 0.75rem (12px) ← Current mobile
   mb-4   // 1rem (16px) ← Current desktop
   mb-5   // 1.25rem (20px)
   mb-6   // 1.5rem (24px)
   mb-8   // 2rem (32px)
   mb-10  // 2.5rem (40px)
   mb-12  // 3rem (48px)
   ```

3. Example: increase bottom margin
   ```tsx
   // More space on mobile
   mb-4 sm:mb-6
   
   // Less space
   mb-2 sm:mb-3
   
   // Custom spacing
   mb-[20px] sm:mb-[32px]
   ```

4. Combined with safe area:
   The `bottom-safe-bottom` class already includes safe area insets. The `mb-` classes add extra margin on top of that.

### Difference
- `pb-` (padding-bottom): space inside the container
- `mb-` (margin-bottom): space outside the container (between container and bottom edge)

Using `mb-` creates space between the button container and the bottom edge, which is typically what you want for bottom-positioned elements.

You can adjust `mb-3 sm:mb-4` to any values you prefer.

Added clear search functionality to both location inputs.

## Changes Summary

### 1. **LocationSearch Component** (`src/components/LocationSearch.tsx`)
   - Added `X` icon import from lucide-react
   - Added `onClear` prop to the interface
   - Added `handleClear` function to clear query, results, and call the onClear callback
   - Added clear button (X icon) that appears when:
     - There's a query/value
     - The input is not disabled
   - Clear button positioned between input and search icon

### 2. **Booking Store** (`src/store/useBookingStore.ts`)
   - Added `unlockPickup` function to unlock pickup when clearing

### 3. **Main Page** (`src/app/page.tsx`)
   - Imported `unlockPickup` from the store
   - Added `onClear` handler for pickup location:
     - Clears pickup state
     - Unlocks pickup if it was locked
     - Clears temp pickup DigiPin
   - Added `onClear` handler for drop-off location:
     - Clears drop state
     - Clears temp destination
     - Resets adjustment mode
     - Clears route distance and geometry

## How It Works

- Pickup Location:
  - Shows clear button when there's text (even if locked)
  - Clicking clear removes the selection and unlocks pickup
  - Resets the search state

- Drop-off Location:
  - Shows clear button when there's a selected destination
  - Clicking clear removes the destination and resets route calculations
  - Only works when pickup is locked (respects disabled state)

The clear button appears as an X icon next to the search icon when there's content to clear.
